risks.risk: Not actually working (magnetron/turntable/control board fault) or intermittent power issues.
risks.proof: A short video of the microwave running (e.g., 30–60 seconds) with the display counting down and a visible heating test (cup of water warming).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not working / needs repair until a run-test is shown.

risks.risk: Door seal or latch problem (can cause arcing, failure to start, or safety issues).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the door latch area and rubber seal + a video showing it starting reliably with the door fully closed.
risks.if_unproven: Price it at a lower tier due to possible safety/door issues.

risks.risk: Unknown model/specs (wattage, capacity) affecting value and comparables.
risks.proof: Photo of the rating plate/label (inside door frame or back) showing brand, model, and wattage/capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic small used microwave with unknown specs.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (turntable ring/roller, glass tray) or damaged interior parts.
risks.proof: Photo of the inside cavity showing the turntable glass/roller and ring installed correctly.

risks.risk: Warranty/guarantee may be claimed but not provided or not valid.
risks.proof: Photo of the guarantee card/receipt and the exact terms (duration, what it covers, contact).

proof_requests: Photo of the rating plate/label with brand + model + wattage/capacity (inside door frame or back).
Video of the microwave running with countdown (and ideally a heating test with water).
Close-up photos of the door latch and rubber seal.
Photo of the turntable glass/roller/ring installed inside the microwave.
